items.question: What was the average order value for all of 2018?
items.text: Average order value (aov) in 2018, per month: 2018-01 131.55; 2018-02 126.49; 2018-03 136.87; 2018-04 143.60; 2018-05 145.31; 2018-06 140.48; 2018-07 140.87; 2018-08 132.20; 2018-09 145. There is no single figure for the period because aov is a ratio, not an amount: it cannot be summed, and an average of the month values would ignore how much each month contributes. Source: certified KPI aov (Average order value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/your-average-order-value-now-has-a-new-definition-in-shopify; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "month" AS grain_value, "aov" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_aov" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "month") = 2018 ORDER BY "month" LIMIT 100
